Perceptions of Market Efficacy, Transaction Costs, and Vertical Integration in Offshore Oil Gathering
abstract:
Sample‐survey information is used to assess aspects of the
predictive competence of the transaction‐cost paradigm. The extent of
vertical disintegration by oil companies in offshore oil gathering is
shown to be consistent with the revealed efficacy of the markets in
intermediate goods and services. Market efficacy is assessed in relation
to oil company perceptions of and other information relating to these
markets.
abstract_zh: 本文利用抽样调查信息，评估交易成本范式预测能力的若干方面。研究表明，近海石油采集企业的纵向分解程度，与其对中间品和服务市场的显示有效性相一致。市场有效性是结合石油公司对这些市场的感知及其他相关信息进行评估的。
